institution: IIITDM Kurnool (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Kurnool)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)
sample_size_caveat: Sample size is notably small (only 6 reviews) compared to other IIITs analyzed, so confidence in this sentiment analysis is lower.

key_positive_themes.notes: Spread across 191 acres; 3 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel; 24/7 wifi for students and faculty; library and indoor badminton stadium available.
Highest-rated category (4.2/5); Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) program noted for strong academic curriculum.
Rated 4.3/5, the strongest category — students feel fees are justified relative to facilities provided.

key_negative_themes.notes: Weakest-rated category (3.6/5); 2019 placement data showed only 72.2% placement rate, average salary of just 4.77 LPA, and only 13 companies participating that year — significantly behind peer IIITs.
Established in 2014, making it one of the newer IIITs, which may explain a still-developing placement ecosystem and smaller alumni network relative to older institutes.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Overview of IIITDM Kurnool - 24/7 wifi, library, hostels for boys and girls, indoor badminton stadium
Awesome college and newer opportunities - 191 acre campus, strong ECE academic curriculum
2019 placement data: 13 companies participated, 72.2% placement rate, average salary 4.77 LPA

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIITDM Kurnool is moderately positive, with students appreciating the large campus, academics, and strong value for money. However, placements remain a clear weak point relative to more established peer IIITs, likely reflecting its comparatively recent founding (2014) and still-developing industry connections. Given the very small review sample, these findings should be treated as indicative rather than conclusive.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a very small sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date. Given the limited sample size (6 reviews), results are illustrative only and not a scientifically robust sentiment study.
